title: High Transaction Velocity
content: Multiple transactions from the same user within a short time window can indicate automated activity, account takeover, or payment abuse. A high transaction count within one hour should increase investigation priority.

title: Repeated Payment Failures
content: Repeated payment failures may indicate card testing, credential attacks, or abnormal payment behavior. Investigate when failed attempts are significantly higher than the user's normal pattern.

title: Unusually High Transaction Amount
content: A transaction substantially larger than a user's normal payment behavior can indicate account takeover or fraudulent activity. High-value transactions should receive additional scrutiny.

title: New Device Activity
content: A transaction originating from a previously unseen device can be a risk signal, especially when combined with other anomalies such as high value or unusual transaction frequency.

title: Geographic Anomaly
content: A transaction originating from an unusual country or geographic location may indicate account compromise. Geographic anomalies should be investigated alongside other transaction signals.
